config._comment: Simulated-learner necessity test (cdlp/validation/necessity_test.py). gap = control score - score without A. n_questions defaults to 3; compare 2 vs 3 for stability before relying on it. Thresholds are a first, uncalibrated choice: with 3 questions graded in 0.5 steps every gap is a multiple of 1/6, so 0.15 / 0.3 / 0.5 separate one, two and three-or-more half-steps. Calibrate on a held-out split, never on the evaluation gold.
